senses.d: a suggestion about what someone should do
senses.e: Let me give you some advice.
senses.ep: بگذار یک توصیه به تو بدهم.

senses.d: to take and use something that belongs to someone else and return it later
to give something to someone for a short time, expecting it back
senses.ep: او چترش را به من قرض داد.

senses.d: to have enough money to buy or do something
senses.e: We can't afford a new car.
senses.ep: از پسِ هزینهٔ ماشین نو برنمی‌آییم.

senses.d: useful and easy for you, causing no difficulty
right for a particular person, purpose, or situation
senses.e: This film is not suitable for children.
senses.ep: این فیلم برای بچه‌ها مناسب نیست.

senses.d: to tell someone you are sorry for having done something wrong
to say that you are not satisfied with something
senses.ep: از سر و صدا شکایت کرد.

senses.d: to agree to take something that is offered
senses.e: I accepted the invitation with pleasure.
senses.ep: دعوت را با کمال میل پذیرفتم.

senses.d: to say that you will not do or accept something
senses.e: She refused to answer the question.
senses.ep: از پاسخ دادن به سؤال امتناع کرد.

senses.d: to say you will give someone something or do something for them
senses.e: He offered to help me with the boxes.
senses.ep: پیشنهاد داد با جعبه‌ها کمکم کند.

senses.d: to make someone remember something they must do
senses.e: Please remind me to call my mother.
senses.ep: لطفاً یادم بیندازد به مادرم زنگ بزنم.
